services.name: Tandem Skydiving
services.desc: Tandem jumping has been around since the early 80's. It is about the EASIEST way to do that "First Jump". With the training, preparation, aircraft ride, jump, and video dubbing, you should plan on being here for about 1/2 a day. Usually, we will have you on your way home in 2-3

services.name: Accelerated Free Fall Ground Course + Level 1
Learn To Skydive
services.desc: Ground Course Your 5 hour ground course includes instruction about the gear you will use, aircraft and exit procedures, freefall body position and altitude awareness, canopy control and landing techniques, as well as emergency proceedure

includes: All equipment included for tandem jumps
Jumpsuit, goggles, and soft leather hat provided
gap: Exact duration of each AFF level jump not stated
blurb: Guests do tandem skydiving jumps from 13,000 or 18,000 feet with freefall and parachute descent, including pre-jump training and optional video/photo packages. They also offer Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) courses with multiple levels for learning to skydive solo. The facility operates year-round and provides all necessary equipment for jumps.
